newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0775 per dollar, up 0.01 percent, on dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1640 local/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $99 million surplus.
Dealers also attributed the slight rise in the local currency to the fact that the stock of dollars maintained by local banks was not as small as expected after Friday's Central Bank buy tender.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dipped 0.02 percent to end at 1.0834 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
